name: The Apocalypse
pages: None living, and few dead, understood why the end of the world happened. And nobody has the full story. You probably weren't around for it - you're just another creature surviving in the ruins of people who knew more than you.$(br2)The first thing you know is that only a rare few Minecraftians - such as yourself - still exist (With more on multiplayer servers).

pages.name: Hordes
pages.text: The second is that dangerous events, such as a horde of zombies or a blood moon, are a frequent occurence.

pages.name: Nether Portal
pages.text: The third is that it's possible to travel between alternate worlds - the Nether and the Aether being the easiest.

pages.title: Further Realms
pages.text: The fourth is that answers lie in the two worlds that are harder or impossible to get to - the worlds of Alfhiem and The End.$(br2)Hover over the Eye of Ender and press 'R' to view the crafting recipe. Information about Alfhiem can eventually be found in the Lexia Botanica.
